The gathering
What to look forward to

The Big Hack Game will pit Stanford against Berkeley in a one-week sprint to build, launch, and grow AI products for real users and enterprise challenges. Participants will get mentorship from YC-backed teams, job referrals, and free boba at the campus kickoff.

From the organizer
Inside the event

On-Campus Kickoff Hubs (No travel needed!): UC Berkeley (Cal Alumni House) & Stanford Campus Stanford vs. Berkeley. One week. Ship an AI agent people pay for. The Big Hack Game is the campus showdown before the Big Game: build, launch, and grow an AI product with real users, solve real problems from enterprise teams, and win it for your school. 🎁 WHAT YOU GET 💼 Job referrals 🧑🏫 Mentorship from YC-backed teams 🧋 Free boba at Campus kickoff!! Extras for winners: 1:1 office hours with top VCs 1:1 YC application mentorship from founders in recent YC batches 💰 PRIZE POOL: $5,000 GUARANTEED, UP TO $10,000 For every 100 attendees, we add $1,000 to the pool, up to $10,000. Invite your friends to apply and grow the pot! 🏆 AWARDS (share of the final prize pool) Grand Champion: 30% ($1,500–$3,000) Real Customer Award: 20% ($1,000–$2,000), VC 1:1 Distribution & Impact: 20% ($1,000–$2,000) School Cup: 20% ($1,000–$2,000), shared among the winning school's winning teams and its school ambassador Best Build Log: 10% ($500–$1,000), shared among the top five ⚖️ JUDGES Judges include YC founders and builders from Microsoft, OpenAI, and Perplexity. Full judge lineup coming soon. 🗓 TIMELINE Team formation: now through Nov 15, 2026 Kickoff: Nov 15, 2026, on campus. Details sent once your application is approved. Build week: Nov 15–20 Demo Day: Nov 20, 2026. Berkeley Kickoff Hub: Sun, Nov 15, 10:00 AM–1:00 PM PT at UC Berkeley (Cal Alumni House) Stanford Kickoff: Campus boba meetup + live kickoff stream Final dates, venue, eligibility, judging criteria, and prize payment rules will be published before registration closes. 🎓 WHO CAN JOIN Stanford and Berkeley students and alumni Industry experts from enterprise AI teams who can bring real-world problems. We'll match experts with student and alumni teams. Please apply with your school or work email if you have one; a personal email is fine otherwise. ⚙️ ABOUT HARNESSROUTER HarnessRouter is a unified interface for agent harnesses
